units.source_text: 名义上是送葬，其实只有两个男人抬着一口用漂白布覆盖的棺材。

en.t: In name it was a funeral procession, but in fact there were only two men carrying a coffin covered with bleached cloth.

units.source_text: 估计这两人是妓馆老板和账房先生。

en.t: I supposed the two men were the brothel owner and the bookkeeper.

units.source_text: 棺材上放着两把铁锹……兴许是葬礼的装饰吧。

en.t: Two iron shovels lay on top of the coffin... perhaps they were funeral decorations.

units.source_text: 这个村庄是实行土葬的。

en.t: This village practiced burial in the ground.
